description: Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Infrastrukturdaten E-Bike Ladestation is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodata.gelsenkirchen.de. The infrastructure database or POI database of the city of Gelsenkirchen offers you extensive information about infrastructures in Gelsenkirchen. They currently have the ability to access over 100 different types of infrastructure, as well as over 7000 datasets from the areas of family, education, leisure, infrastructure, culture, administration, social and economics. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "City of Gelsenkirchen: Infrastructure data E-bike charging station" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Stadt Gelsenkirchen, E-Bike, opendata, Datensatz, Lokal, Ladestation. The listing shows 2025-03-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
